extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: 23.6 x 23.6 m motorway tile (2 x 2 kit grid): 2 x (0.5 m edge strip + 2 x 3.75 m lanes + 2.2 m hard shoulder) of asphalt, 2.0 m grass median with double-sided steel guard rail (A-profile on sigma posts every 1.97 m), 0.6 m gravel verges, one delineator post per side
extras.notes: Tileable along X: seam edges at x = +-11.8 m, guard rails sit in base position at both seams, posts and markings repeat with an 11.8 m period (lane line 4 m dash / 7.8 m gap, seams mid-gap; 0.15 m left edge line, 0.30 m right edge line). Right-hand traffic: the -Y carriageway runs towards +X. Asphalt map 11.8 m long (repeats twice per tile), lanes with wheel tracks, longitudinal paving joints. Pivot on the carriageway surface (z = 0), base -0.20 m. No bottom faces. Guard rail and delineators baked PBR, road surfaces keep their texture sets.

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
